title: Dashboard Snapshot Extension — Dependency State
description: New fields added to the dashboard SSE snapshot payload for card dependency visibility (spec 046).

blocked_by_dependencies.description: List of unsatisfied blocker cards for the current active card. Empty array when the card has no pending dependencies or when no card is active.

issue_number.description: GitHub issue number of the blocking card.

title.description: Title of the blocking card. Null if the issue is not on the board.

column.description: Current board column of the blocking card (e.g. 'IN_PROGRESS', 'TODO'). Null if the issue is not on the board.

issue_url.description: GitHub issue URL for the blocker. Null if unavailable.

source.description: How the dependency was detected: 'explicit' (parsed from issue body) or 'assessor' (flagged by the assessor role).
